title: Network Management: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS. THE LAST PAGE OF THE ORIGINAL SCAN IS MISSING, SO QUESTIONS MARKED [PREDICTED] WERE WRITTEN TO COMPLETE THE PAPER AND ARE NOT FROM THE PRINTED PAPER.

parts.text: Explain the difference between static and dynamic IP addresses.
Explain how you would troubleshoot an internet connection in the LAN.
Explain the functions of the following layers of the OSI model.
Transport layer
Presentation layer
Discuss briefly the functions of each of the following communication devices.
Switch
Repeater
Gateway
Router
Wireless access point
Explain the factors to consider while planning for a network.
Explain why fibre optic cable is preferred as a medium of data transmission over other media.
Explain the factors that affect network design.
Outline the factors to consider when choosing a network operating system.
Describe the techniques of procuring network resources.
Describe the four components that need to be installed and configured in the Local Area Connection properties dialog to enable network communication and sharing.
Explain the challenges faced by network administrators while they are managing an organization network.
Describe what crosstalk is and explain what networking hardware can be used to eliminate it.
Giving reasons, justify why modern-day enterprises should hire a network manager.
Describe the following TCP command line utilities.
ipconfig
traceroute
ping
Give the main difference between the following.
Simplex and full duplex
Terrestrial microwave and satellite
TCP/IP protocol suite and OSI model
[Predicted] Explain the role of a network security policy in an organization.
[Predicted] Describe the five functional areas of network management.
[Predicted] Explain the benefits of network documentation.
[Predicted] Differentiate between peer-to-peer and client-server networks.
